sentences.text: Subsidized Scheme for Widows: Haryana Women Development Corporation

**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Haryana Domiciled Widow, Divorced, and Legally Separated Women. Through this scheme, a subsidy on the total loan is provided.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Women and Child

**Detailed Description:** The scheme "Subsidized Scheme for Widows" by the Women & Child Development Department, Haryana Government, aims to provide financial assistance to Haryana-domiciled widows, divorced, and Legally Separated Women. Through this scheme, a subsidy on the total loan is provided. The scheme is covered without collateral security by the bank. The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Women Development Corporation.

**Benefits / Assistance:** 1. A 25% flat subsidy, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/-, will be provided on the total loan (not as a capital subsidy). 1. The beneficiary's share is 10% of the total loan. 1. The maximum loan limit is ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The scheme will be covered under without collateral security by the bank. 1. The balance amount will be covered from commercial/nationalised banks.  > **Mode of Disbursement:** The balance amount will be covered from commercial/nationalised banks. > **Moratorium Period:** The moratorium period will be three months after disbursement of the loan.
**Exclusions / Not eligible:** 1. No subsidy for interest accrued on a delayed period will be allowed in case of default of payment of EMI.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process on Antyodaya-SARAL Portal:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** For registration, click on “New User/Register Here” and fill in all the mandatory details i.e. Name, Email ID, Mobile Number &amp; password. Click on ‘Submit’. **Step 3:** Verify the OTP received in the provided Email and Mobile Number. Alternatively, click on the Verification Link to activate the profile. > **Login to Apply for the Scheme:** **Step 1:** Visit the Official Portal: [Antyodaya-SARAL Portal.](https://saralharyana.gov.in/) **Step 2:** The “Sign in here” option is available on the right side of the screen. Fill in the required credentials and click on the ‘Login’ button. **Step 3:** In the opened window, click on “Scheme/Services list” and a list of schemes will appear on the screen. **Step 4:** Now, select the scheme and click on “Apply for Service/Scheme”. **Step 5:** Fill in all the details in the online application form and click on &quot;Submit&quot;. > **Track Your Service Online:** - **Track Application/Appeal:** [Click here](https://status.saralharyana.nic.in/). - **Track Ticket:** [Click here](https://eticketing.saralharyana.nic.in/CitizenViewComplaints.aspx). > **Track Your Service Through SMS:** - **Registered Mobile Number:** Type SARAL and send to 9954699899 to track your application. - **Other Mobile Number:** Type SARAL&lt;space&gt;&lt;Application ID/Ticket No.&gt; and send to 9954699899 to track your application/ticket. > **Contact Us:** **Helpline:** 0172-3968400 **Email:** saral.haryana@gov.in &amp;gt; **Fees For Service:** - Government Charges: ₹0 (No Fee) - Service Charges: ₹10 - Atal Seva Kendra Charges: ₹10
**Additional Application Processes:** **Process 2:** The eligible applicant may visit the nearest Atal Seva Kendra with all the required documents to apply for the scheme.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Women and Child Development Department
